description:
## Context

`apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex` currently routes keyboard events via hardcoded guards:
- `state.model_selector != nil` → ModelSelector
- Dequeue overlay check
- Input component as final fallback

12 component modules exist but none are dispatched through a unified layer.

Elixir Component behaviour (`apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/component.ex`):
```elixir
@callback render(state :: struct(), width :: pos_integer()) :: [binary()]
@callback handle_key(state :: struct(), key :: Key.t()) :: struct() | {struct(), [term()]}
@optional_callbacks handle_key: 2
```

This ticket is the **architectural prerequisite** for both opi-component-display and opi-component-selectors.

## Implementation steps

### 1. Read interactive.ex in full before all changes

Map out:
- `State` struct fields
- All `handle_event/2` clauses and their guard conditions
- How `render_frame/1` produces output
- The `dispatch_app_action/3` function

### 2. Add focused_component to State

```elixir
focused_component: :input | {:dialog, atom()} | {:overlay, atom()} | nil
```

Initialize as `:input` in `init/2`.

### 3. Create dispatch_key_to_focused/2

```elixir
defp dispatch_key_to_focused(state, %Key{} = key) do
  case state.focused_component do
    :input -> handle_input_key(state, key)
    {:dialog, :model_selector} -> handle_model_selector_key(state, key)
    {:dialog, :dequeue} -> handle_dequeue_key(state, key)
    {:dialog, :login} -> handle_login_dialog_key(state, key)
    {:dialog, :settings} -> handle_settings_dialog_key(state, key)
    {:dialog, :session_selector} -> handle_session_selector_key(state, key)
    {:dialog, :tree_selector} -> handle_tree_selector_key(state, key)
    {:dialog, :summarize_prompt} -> handle_summarize_prompt_key(state, key)
    nil -> state
  end
end
```

Extract existing `handle_event/2` clauses for ModelSelector and dequeue overlay into their corresponding `handle_*_key` private functions. Refactor `handle_event/2` to call `dispatch_key_to_focused/2`.

### 4. Add event aggregation

Components may return `{new_state, events}`. Add:

```elixir
defp apply_component_result(state, component_field, result) do
  case result do
    {new_component, events} ->
      state = Map.put(state, component_field, new_component)
      Enum.reduce(events, state, &handle_component_event(&2, &1))
    new_component ->
      Map.put(state, component_field, new_component)
  end
end

defp handle_component_event(state, event) do
  # Route component-emitted events: {:submit, value}, {:cancel}, {:select, item}, etc.
  case event do
    {:cancel} -> unfocus(state)
    # other events TBD per component
    _ -> state
  end
end
```

### 5. Add focus helpers

```elixir
defp focus(state, target), do: %{state | focused_component: target}
defp unfocus(state), do: %{state | focused_component: :input}
```

Replace inline `model_selector != nil` guards with `focus/2`/`unfocus/2` calls.

### 6. Add invalidate/1 stub to all 12 component modules

For each module listed, add (if missing):
```elixir
@spec invalidate(t()) :: t()
def invalidate(state), do: state
```

Modules:
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/container.ex`
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/custom_message.ex`
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/diff.ex`
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/header.ex`
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/login_dialog.ex`
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/select_list.ex`
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/session_selector.ex`
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/settings_list.ex`
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/settings_selector.ex`
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/summarize_prompt.ex`
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/tree_selector.ex`
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/truncated_text.ex`

Also add `invalidate` as `@optional_callbacks invalidate: 1` to the `OctoPi.TUI.Component` behaviour module.

### 7. Tests

- Key events dispatch to correct handler based on `focused_component`
- `focus/2` transitions correctly; `unfocus/2` returns to `:input`
- A component returning `{state, [{:cancel}]}` triggers `unfocus/1`
- All existing interactive tests pass (no regression)

## Notes
- This is the largest architectural change in the series. Read the full interactive.ex before starting.
- Extract-and-route (not rewrite-from-scratch) reduces risk.
- The `invalidate/1` stubs are mechanical — do not skip them.
title: Refactor Interactive loop to unified component dispatch (focus stack, event aggregation, invalidate stubs)
